name: BuildingModelPlaceholder
intent: A dependency-free CSS-3D building placeholder (one extruded box per floor, drag-to-orbit, click-to-select) that stands in for a real BIM / 3D model when one isn't available yet.
when: A building's floors need a 3D-ish preview but no BIM model exists
Selecting a floor from a lightweight 3D stand-in

chooseOver.because: BuildingModelPlaceholder is a zero-dependency stand-in used only until a real model is wired up

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation
